subject: System Design
title: Synchronous Communication
description: A quick win: understand Synchronous Communication.

hook.text: Service A calls Service B and waits for a response. If B is slow, A is slow too. They're coupled by time.

buildup.text: REST and gRPC are synchronous: the caller blocks until the callee responds or a timeout is reached.

discovery.text: Synchronous calls are simple to reason about. Request in, response out. The flow is linear and predictable.

twist.text: A chain of synchronous calls amplifies latency and failure. If any link in the chain fails, the whole request fails.

climax.text: Synchronous communication works for simple request-response. Avoid deep synchronous chains across many services.

punchline.text: Call and wait — simple but every service in the chain must be fast.

quiz.question: What is the risk of synchronous service chains?
options: If any service in the chain fails or is slow, the entire request fails
